intel.title: [CISA KEV] Apache Roller - Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-129448
廠商: Apache
產品: Roller
漏洞名稱: Apache Roller Deserialization of Untrusted Data Vulnerability
說明: Apache Roller contains a deserialization of untrusted data vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated remote attacker to execute arbitrary code via the XML-RPC endpoint, which accepts and deserializes vendor extension types before authentication. This CVE covers the same underlying vulnerability as CVE-2026-82384 but applies to a broader range of affected versions.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-23
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Apache Roller 存在未經身份驗證的反序列化漏洞（CVE-2026-129448），攻擊者可透過 XML-RPC 端點遠端執行任意程式碼。此漏洞已被 CISA 收錄於已知被利用漏洞清單（KEV）中。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Broadcom VMware vCenter - VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-123890
廠商: Broadcom
產品: VMware vCenter
漏洞名稱: VMWare vCenter Authentication Bypass Using an Alternate Path or Channel Vulnerability
說明: Broadcom VMware vCenter contains an authentication bypass using an alternate path or channel vulnerability in the VMware Directory Service that allows an unauthenticated attacker with network access to vCenter to bypass authentication and gain unauthorized access to the system.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines
修補截止日: 2026-11-23
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: CISA KEV 將 Broadcom VMware vCenter 的身分驗證旁路漏洞（CVE-2026-123890）列入已知遭利用漏洞清單。未經驗證的攻擊者可經由網路繞過身份驗證並取得 vCenter 系統的未授權存取權限。公司內部部署有 VMware vSphere 虛擬化平台環境，面臨重大資安威脅。
analysis.recommendation: 請 RR40 部門立即參照 Broadcom 官方公告更新 VMware vCenter 至安全版本；若暫時無法完成修補，應立即對 vCenter 及 VMware Directory Service 實施嚴格的網路存取控制（如限制管理網段 IP 及套用 WAF/防火牆規則）。
affected_assets: 資訊軟體-虛擬平台軟體-DELL OEM Vmware DELL vSphere Essentials Plus Kit
資訊軟體-虛擬平台軟體-VMWare Esxi6.5

intel.title: [CISA KEV] SAP NetWeaver - SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2025-42884
廠商: SAP
產品: NetWeaver
漏洞名稱: SAP NetWeaver Improper Neutralization of Special Elements in Data Query Logic Vulnerability
說明: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal contains an improper neutralization of special elements in data query logic vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated attacker to disclose or modify server information via injected JNDI environment properties or a URL used during JNDI lookup operations.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-23
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: SAP NetWeaver Enterprise Portal 存在數據查詢邏輯驗證不當漏洞（CVE-2025-42884）。未經身份驗證的遠端攻擊者可透過注入 JNDI 環境屬性或 URL 執行 JNDI 尋找操作，進而存取或修改伺服器敏感資訊。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。

intel.title: [CISA KEV] Cisco Expressway Series - Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
intel.raw_content:
CVE: CVE-2026-76466
廠商: Cisco
產品: Expressway Series
漏洞名稱: Cisco Expressway Series Use of Hard-coded Credentials Vulnerability
說明: Cisco Expressway Series contains a use of hard-coded credentials vulnerability that allows an unauthenticated, remote attacker with persistent cookies and network access to execute commands as root on a clustered device via the database service.
CISA 要求措施: Apply mitigations in accordance with vendor instructions, ensuring compliance with CISA’s BOD 26-04 Prioritizing Security Updates Based on Risk (see URL in Notes) guidance and CISA’s “Forensics Triage Requirements” (see URL in Notes). Follow applicable BOD 26-04 guidance for cloud services or discontinue use of the product if mitigations are unavailable. Stakeholders are responsible for evaluating each asset's internet exposure and ensuring adherence to BOD 26-04 patching guidelines.
修補截止日: 2026-11-23
已知勒索軟體利用: Unknown

analysis.summary: Cisco Expressway Series 存在硬編碼憑證漏洞（CVE-2026-76466），遠端未經身份驗證的攻擊者可利用該漏洞取得集群設備的 root 權限並執行指令。此漏洞已被 CISA 列入已知遭利用漏洞清單（KEV），具備高度潛在威脅。
analysis.recommendation: 公司資產清冊未包含受影響資產，無需處置。
